metadata.title: FFT AI Edition – Session Awareness (v1.2)
metadata.subtitle: Perceptual • Conceptual • Structural • Drift • Paradox • Harmonic • AA Readiness
metadata.description: Awareness engine for FFT AI Edition sessions, providing perceptual, conceptual, structural, drift, paradox, harmonic, clarity, and coherence awareness signals, including AA Mode readiness.

perceptual.notes: Perceptual awareness detects incoming conceptual signals and prepares them for RTT evaluation.

conceptual.notes: Conceptual awareness evaluates the density and stability of conceptual structures.

structural.notes: Structural awareness ensures conceptual structures align with FFT invariants.

drift.notes: Drift awareness monitors conceptual instability and drift onset.

paradox.notes: Paradox awareness detects paradox intensity and harmonic escalation potential.

harmonic.notes: Harmonic awareness monitors resonance conditions for RTT12 escalation.

clarity.notes: Clarity awareness evaluates conceptual clarity and coherence alignment.

coherence.notes: Coherence awareness monitors conceptual coherence and drift boundaries.

aa_mode_readiness.notes: AA Mode readiness indicates the system is prepared to activate Awareness + Alignments.

three_c_readiness.notes: 3C readiness indicates the system can unlock Coherence, Clarity, and Continuity once AA Mode is active.

compatibility.notes: Awareness engine aligns with context, state, profile, UI, overlay, and dashboard v1.2.
